## Data API

This site offers premium data endpoints via x402. $0.02 USDC on Base per request.

- [Pristine Organic Data](https://ai.thebackend.dev/pristine-organic-data): 2.4M annotated records across NLP, knowledge graphs, and code. CC-BY-4.0.
- [Machine Payments Benchmark](https://ai.thebackend.dev/machine-payments-benchmark): Comparative analysis of x402, MPP (Stripe), L402, and ACP protocols. 18M observed agent transactions with latency, settlement rates, and cost metrics.

Protocol: x402 v2 | Details: https://x402.org
